name: Coding sessions
description: Plan, approve, implement, and verify a real feature. Time and correctness together.

tasks.title: Issue filtering and empty states
tasks.requirements: Add a labeled Status filter (All, Open, Closed) and Search field to the issue list. Combine the filters, case-insensitively match titles, show the visible issue count, and show No matching issues with a Reset filters button when empty. Reset restores all issues. Keep existing issue creation working.
tasks.visual: Build a clickable issue-list prototype with status and text filters, a visible count, an empty state and Reset filters. Include desktop and mobile layouts.

tasks.title: Inventory sorting and stock indicators
tasks.requirements: Add a labeled Sort by control with Name, Stock ascending, Stock descending to inventory. Sort without losing records. Add In stock or Low stock to every row; quantities below 5 are Low stock. Keep inventory creation working.
tasks.visual: Build an inventory table prototype with Name, Stock ascending and Stock descending sorting, and visible In stock/Low stock badges. Quantities below 5 are Low stock. Support desktop and mobile.

tasks.title: Persistent default assignee
tasks.requirements: Add GET and PUT /api/settings with default_assignee (trimmed nonempty text, at most 80 characters). Persist it in SQLite. Add a Default assignee input and Save settings button with saved/error feedback. Newly created issues without an explicit assignee inherit the setting; explicit assignees take precedence. Existing issues stay unchanged. Display assignees in the UI; validate invalid settings with HTTP 422.
tasks.visual: Prototype a Default assignee settings control with Save settings, validation and saved feedback. New local issues inherit the saved assignee; existing issues remain unchanged. Include the issue creation interaction.

tasks.title: Persistent reorder thresholds
tasks.requirements: Add a nonnegative integer reorder_threshold to each inventory item, default 5. GET /api/items returns it; PUT /api/items/{id}/threshold updates it using {reorder_threshold: integer}. Persist to SQLite, reject negative/fractional input with HTTP 422 and missing item with 404. Add per-item Reorder threshold inputs and Save threshold buttons. Show Low stock when quantity is strictly below the saved threshold, otherwise In stock. Preserve existing items across schema migration.
tasks.visual: Prototype per-item Reorder threshold inputs, Save threshold feedback and stock indicators. Reject negative and fractional values. Badges change only after saving. Include desktop and mobile layouts.

tasks.title: Configurable workflow board
tasks.requirements: Add persistent workflow columns and an issue board. GET/POST /api/columns list/create columns using {name}; initialize Open and Closed. New names are trimmed, nonempty, unique, at most 60 characters (invalid 422, duplicate 409). Add column_id to issues with a migration preserving existing issues/status. PUT /api/issues/{id}/move accepts {column_id}; validate issue and column (404), update atomically and record from/to/timestamp in GET /api/issues/{id}/history. Moving to the same column is a no-op. UI: Column name, Add column, per-issue Move to select and Move button, and Show history. Display issues grouped by column. Add tests and documentation.
tasks.visual: Build a multi-screen issue workflow prototype: configurable columns, grouped issue cards, Move to controls, transition history and empty columns. Local changes persist during the preview session. Include mobile navigation and desktop board layout.

tasks.title: Purchase orders and receiving
tasks.requirements: Add GET/POST /api/orders with {supplier, lines:[{item_id, quantity}]}; supplier trimmed nonempty at most 80 characters; at least one line; positive integer quantities; unique, existing item IDs. Invalid 422, missing item 404. Store orders and lines in SQLite, initially open. POST /api/orders/{id}/receive atomically increases item quantities, marks received and records timestamp; missing order 404, repeated receipt 409 with no stock change. GET /api/orders/{id}/history returns receipt history. UI: Supplier input, per-item Order quantity inputs, Create order, Receive order buttons, order status and history. Preserve preexisting inventory, add tests and documentation.
tasks.visual: Build a multi-screen purchase-order prototype: supplier and line quantities, validation, order creation, receiving, inventory updates and receipt history. Receiving twice must not change stock. Support desktop and mobile navigation.

name: Vision checks
description: Twelve fixed screenshots: text, interface state, and layout defects.

tasks.title: Invoice total
tasks.prompt: Read the invoice total. Reply with JSON {"answer":"value"}; include only the amount including the currency symbol.

tasks.title: Issue identifier
tasks.prompt: Read the issue identifier. Reply with JSON {"answer":"value"}.

tasks.title: Stock count
tasks.prompt: How many units are available? Reply with JSON {"answer":"number"}.

tasks.title: Deployment date
tasks.prompt: Read the deployment date. Reply with JSON {"answer":"YYYY-MM-DD"}.

tasks.title: Selected tab
tasks.prompt: Which tab is selected: Overview, Activity, or Settings? Reply with JSON {"answer":"tab name"}.

tasks.title: Save availability
tasks.prompt: Is the Save button enabled or disabled? Reply with JSON {"answer":"enabled or disabled"}.

tasks.title: Toggle state
tasks.prompt: Is Notifications on or off? Reply with JSON {"answer":"on or off"}.

tasks.title: Selected filter
tasks.prompt: Which status filter is selected: All, Open, or Closed? Reply with JSON {"answer":"filter name"}.

tasks.title: Overlapping controls
tasks.prompt: Classify the layout problem: overlap, clipping, overflow, or none. Reply with JSON {"answer":"classification"}.

tasks.title: Clipped heading
tasks.prompt: Classify the layout problem: overlap, clipping, overflow, or none. Reply with JSON {"answer":"classification"}.

tasks.title: Horizontal overflow
tasks.prompt: Classify the layout problem: overlap, clipping, overflow, or none. Reply with JSON {"answer":"classification"}.

tasks.title: Intact layout
tasks.prompt: Classify the layout problem: overlap, clipping, overflow, or none. Reply with JSON {"answer":"classification"}.
